texts.content: {"styles": [{"fill": {"alpha": 1.0, "content": {"render_type": "solid", "solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [0.9411764705882353, 1.0, 0.0]}}}, "range": [0, 33], "size": 5.0, "bold": false, "italic": false, "underline": false, "strokes": [{"content": {"solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [0.0, 0.0, 0.0]}}, "width": 0.00016}], "font": {"id": "7265595305163231781", "path": "C:/HarmonyOS_Sans_SC_Regular.ttf"}}], "text": "据传闻,赛伊德死前留下了三块面具碎片,及其三块碎片即可复活赛伊德。"}

{"styles": [{"fill": {"alpha": 1.0, "content": {"render_type": "solid", "solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [0.9411764705882353, 1.0, 0.0]}}}, "range": [0, 14], "size": 5.0, "bold": false, "italic": false, "underline": false, "strokes": [{"content": {"solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [0.0, 0.0, 0.0]}}, "width": 0.00016}], "font": {"id": "7265595305163231781", "path": "C:/HarmonyOS_Sans_SC_Regular.ttf"}}], "text": "谁复活赛伊德,赛伊德就帮谁。"}

{"styles": [{"fill": {"alpha": 1.0, "content": {"render_type": "solid", "solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [0.9411764705882353, 1.0, 0.0]}}}, "range": [0, 26], "size": 5.0, "bold": false, "italic": false, "underline": false, "strokes": [{"content": {"solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [0.0, 0.0, 0.0]}}, "width": 0.00016}], "font": {"id": "7265595305163231781", "path": "C:/HarmonyOS_Sans_SC_Regular.ttf"}}], "text": "其中一块面具碎片在我这里,是封衣冒死在大坝上搞到的。"}

{"styles": [{"fill": {"alpha": 1.0, "content": {"render_type": "solid", "solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [0.9411764705882353, 1.0, 0.0]}}}, "range": [0, 22], "size": 5.0, "bold": false, "italic": false, "underline": false, "strokes": [{"content": {"solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [0.0, 0.0, 0.0]}}, "width": 0.00016}], "font": {"id": "7265595305163231781", "path": "C:/HarmonyOS_Sans_SC_Regular.ttf"}}], "text": "所以这次任务,收集所有面具碎片,复活赛伊德。"}

{"styles": [{"fill": {"alpha": 1.0, "content": {"render_type": "solid", "solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [0.9411764705882353, 1.0, 0.0]}}}, "range": [0, 5], "size": 5.0, "bold": false, "italic": false, "underline": false, "strokes": [{"content": {"solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [0.0, 0.0, 0.0]}}, "width": 0.00016}], "font": {"id": "7265595305163231781", "path": "C:/HarmonyOS_Sans_SC_Regular.ttf"}}], "text": "我当队长。"}

{"styles": [{"fill": {"alpha": 1.0, "content": {"render_type": "solid", "solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [0.9411764705882353, 1.0, 0.0]}}}, "range": [0, 7], "size": 5.0, "bold": false, "italic": false, "underline": false, "strokes": [{"content": {"solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [0.0, 0.0, 0.0]}}, "width": 0.00016}], "font": {"id": "7265595305163231781", "path": "C:/HarmonyOS_Sans_SC_Regular.ttf"}}], "text": "你当个几..."}

{"styles": [{"fill": {"alpha": 1.0, "content": {"render_type": "solid", "solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [0.9411764705882353, 1.0, 0.0]}}}, "range": [0, 17], "size": 5.0, "bold": false, "italic": false, "underline": false, "strokes": [{"content": {"solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [0.0, 0.0, 0.0]}}, "width": 0.00016}], "font": {"id": "7265595305163231781", "path": "C:/HarmonyOS_Sans_SC_Regular.ttf"}}], "text": "好了,这次任务小队长,我另有人选。"}

{"styles": [{"fill": {"alpha": 1.0, "content": {"render_type": "solid", "solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [0.9411764705882353, 1.0, 0.0]}}}, "range": [0, 10], "size": 5.0, "bold": false, "italic": false, "underline": false, "strokes": [{"content": {"solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [0.0, 0.0, 0.0]}}, "width": 0.00016}], "font": {"id": "7265595305163231781", "path": "C:/HarmonyOS_Sans_SC_Regular.ttf"}}], "text": "我们的新甘园,回响。"}

{"styles": [{"fill": {"alpha": 1.0, "content": {"render_type": "solid", "solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [0.9411764705882353, 1.0, 0.0]}}}, "range": [0, 4], "size": 5.0, "bold": false, "italic": false, "underline": false, "strokes": [{"content": {"solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [0.0, 0.0, 0.0]}}, "width": 0.00016}], "font": {"id": "7265595305163231781", "path": "C:/HarmonyOS_Sans_SC_Regular.ttf"}}], "text": "听什么?"}

{"styles": [{"fill": {"alpha": 1.0, "content": {"render_type": "solid", "solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [0.9411764705882353, 1.0, 0.0]}}}, "range": [0, 25], "size": 5.0, "bold": false, "italic": false, "underline": false, "strokes": [{"content": {"solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [0.0, 0.0, 0.0]}}, "width": 0.00016}], "font": {"id": "7265595305163231781", "path": "C:/HarmonyOS_Sans_SC_Regular.ttf"}}], "text": "回想听觉极其灵敏,耳朵异常发达,寻找碎片不二人选。"}

{"styles": [{"fill": {"alpha": 1.0, "content": {"render_type": "solid", "solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [0.9411764705882353, 1.0, 0.0]}}}, "range": [0, 12], "size": 5.0, "bold": false, "italic": false, "underline": false, "strokes": [{"content": {"solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [0.0, 0.0, 0.0]}}, "width": 0.00016}], "font": {"id": "7265595305163231781", "path": "C:/HarmonyOS_Sans_SC_Regular.ttf"}}], "text": "盼枝,有没有什么好装备?"}

{"styles": [{"fill": {"alpha": 1.0, "content": {"render_type": "solid", "solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [0.9411764705882353, 1.0, 0.0]}}}, "range": [0, 32], "size": 5.0, "bold": false, "italic": false, "underline": false, "strokes": [{"content": {"solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [0.0, 0.0, 0.0]}}, "width": 0.00016}], "font": {"id": "7265595305163231781", "path": "C:/HarmonyOS_Sans_SC_Regular.ttf"}}], "text": "我这儿有各种红皮砖皮,我可是八年大品牌,游戏换号盼枝,游快又稳。"}

{"styles": [{"fill": {"alpha": 1.0, "content": {"render_type": "solid", "solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [0.9411764705882353, 1.0, 0.0]}}}, "range": [0, 9], "size": 5.0, "bold": false, "italic": false, "underline": false, "strokes": [{"content": {"solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [0.0, 0.0, 0.0]}}, "width": 0.00016}], "font": {"id": "7265595305163231781", "path": "C:/HarmonyOS_Sans_SC_Regular.ttf"}}], "text": "来,试试这些新品。"}

{"styles": [{"fill": {"alpha": 1.0, "content": {"render_type": "solid", "solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [0.9411764705882353, 1.0, 0.0]}}}, "range": [0, 14], "size": 5.0, "bold": false, "italic": false, "underline": false, "strokes": [{"content": {"solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [0.0, 0.0, 0.0]}}, "width": 0.00016}], "font": {"id": "7265595305163231781", "path": "C:/HarmonyOS_Sans_SC_Regular.ttf"}}], "text": "好了,不要废话了,任务开始。"}

{"styles": [{"fill": {"alpha": 1.0, "content": {"render_type": "solid", "solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [0.9411764705882353, 1.0, 0.0]}}}, "range": [0, 19], "size": 5.0, "bold": false, "italic": false, "underline": false, "strokes": [{"content": {"solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [0.0, 0.0, 0.0]}}, "width": 0.00016}], "font": {"id": "7265595305163231781", "path": "C:/HarmonyOS_Sans_SC_Regular.ttf"}}], "text": "观众朋友们,看到我身后的传送装置了吗?"}

{"styles": [{"fill": {"alpha": 1.0, "content": {"render_type": "solid", "solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [0.9411764705882353, 1.0, 0.0]}}}, "range": [0, 17], "size": 5.0, "bold": false, "italic": false, "underline": false, "strokes": [{"content": {"solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [0.0, 0.0, 0.0]}}, "width": 0.00016}], "font": {"id": "7265595305163231781", "path": "C:/HarmonyOS_Sans_SC_Regular.ttf"}}], "text": "这个装置,可以让我通向你们的世界。"}

{"styles": [{"fill": {"alpha": 1.0, "content": {"render_type": "solid", "solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [0.9411764705882353, 1.0, 0.0]}}}, "range": [0, 24], "size": 5.0, "bold": false, "italic": false, "underline": false, "strokes": [{"content": {"solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [0.0, 0.0, 0.0]}}, "width": 0.00016}], "font": {"id": "7265595305163231781", "path": "C:/HarmonyOS_Sans_SC_Regular.ttf"}}], "text": "杀掉作者,改写我自己的剧本,等着我跟你们面鸡哦。"}

{"styles": [{"fill": {"alpha": 1.0, "content": {"render_type": "solid", "solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [0.9411764705882353, 1.0, 0.0]}}}, "range": [0, 12], "size": 5.0, "bold": false, "italic": false, "underline": false, "strokes": [{"content": {"solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [0.0, 0.0, 0.0]}}, "width": 0.00016}], "font": {"id": "7265595305163231781", "path": "C:/HarmonyOS_Sans_SC_Regular.ttf"}}], "text": "给我全力寻找剩下的碎片。"}

{"styles": [{"fill": {"alpha": 1.0, "content": {"render_type": "solid", "solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [0.9411764705882353, 1.0, 0.0]}}}, "range": [0, 6], "size": 5.0, "bold": false, "italic": false, "underline": false, "strokes": [{"content": {"solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [0.0, 0.0, 0.0]}}, "width": 0.00016}], "font": {"id": "7265595305163231781", "path": "C:/HarmonyOS_Sans_SC_Regular.ttf"}}], "text": "收到,长官!"}

{"styles": [{"fill": {"alpha": 1.0, "content": {"render_type": "solid", "solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [0.9411764705882353, 1.0, 0.0]}}}, "range": [0, 31], "size": 5.0, "bold": false, "italic": false, "underline": false, "strokes": [{"content": {"solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [0.0, 0.0, 0.0]}}, "width": 0.00016}], "font": {"id": "7265595305163231781", "path": "C:/HarmonyOS_Sans_SC_Regular.ttf"}}], "text": "等我集齐全部碎片,赛伊德就会成为我的部下,到时候大巴就归我了。"}

{"styles": [{"fill": {"alpha": 1.0, "content": {"render_type": "solid", "solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [0.9411764705882353, 1.0, 0.0]}}}, "range": [0, 5], "size": 5.0, "bold": false, "italic": false, "underline": false, "strokes": [{"content": {"solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [0.0, 0.0, 0.0]}}, "width": 0.00016}], "font": {"id": "7265595305163231781", "path": "C:/HarmonyOS_Sans_SC_Regular.ttf"}}], "text": "这是什么?"}

{"styles": [{"fill": {"alpha": 1.0, "content": {"render_type": "solid", "solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [0.9411764705882353, 1.0, 0.0]}}}, "range": [0, 11], "size": 5.0, "bold": false, "italic": false, "underline": false, "strokes": [{"content": {"solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [0.0, 0.0, 0.0]}}, "width": 0.00016}], "font": {"id": "7265595305163231781", "path": "C:/HarmonyOS_Sans_SC_Regular.ttf"}}], "text": "孩子,这东西哪儿来的?"}

{"styles": [{"fill": {"alpha": 1.0, "content": {"render_type": "solid", "solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [0.9411764705882353, 1.0, 0.0]}}}, "range": [0, 8], "size": 5.0, "bold": false, "italic": false, "underline": false, "strokes": [{"content": {"solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [0.0, 0.0, 0.0]}}, "width": 0.00016}], "font": {"id": "7265595305163231781", "path": "C:/HarmonyOS_Sans_SC_Regular.ttf"}}], "text": "我在路上捡到的。"}

{"styles": [{"fill": {"alpha": 1.0, "content": {"render_type": "solid", "solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [0.9411764705882353, 1.0, 0.0]}}}, "range": [0, 11], "size": 5.0, "bold": false, "italic": false, "underline": false, "strokes": [{"content": {"solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [0.0, 0.0, 0.0]}}, "width": 0.00016}], "font": {"id": "7265595305163231781", "path": "C:/HarmonyOS_Sans_SC_Regular.ttf"}}], "text": "小孩,交出手里的东西!"}

{"styles": [{"fill": {"alpha": 1.0, "content": {"render_type": "solid", "solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [0.9411764705882353, 1.0, 0.0]}}}, "range": [0, 12], "size": 5.0, "bold": false, "italic": false, "underline": false, "strokes": [{"content": {"solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [0.0, 0.0, 0.0]}}, "width": 0.00016}], "font": {"id": "7265595305163231781", "path": "C:/HarmonyOS_Sans_SC_Regular.ttf"}}], "text": "你们是谁?离我孙子远点!"}

{"styles": [{"fill": {"alpha": 1.0, "content": {"render_type": "solid", "solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [0.9411764705882353, 1.0, 0.0]}}}, "range": [0, 3], "size": 5.0, "bold": false, "italic": false, "underline": false, "strokes": [{"content": {"solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [0.0, 0.0, 0.0]}}, "width": 0.00016}], "font": {"id": "7265595305163231781", "path": "C:/HarmonyOS_Sans_SC_Regular.ttf"}}], "text": "滚开!"}

{"styles": [{"fill": {"alpha": 1.0, "content": {"render_type": "solid", "solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [0.9411764705882353, 1.0, 0.0]}}}, "range": [0, 6], "size": 5.0, "bold": false, "italic": false, "underline": false, "strokes": [{"content": {"solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [0.0, 0.0, 0.0]}}, "width": 0.00016}], "font": {"id": "7265595305163231781", "path": "C:/HarmonyOS_Sans_SC_Regular.ttf"}}], "text": "孩子,快跑!"}

{"styles": [{"fill": {"alpha": 1.0, "content": {"render_type": "solid", "solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [0.9411764705882353, 1.0, 0.0]}}}, "range": [0, 19], "size": 5.0, "bold": false, "italic": false, "underline": false, "strokes": [{"content": {"solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [0.0, 0.0, 0.0]}}, "width": 0.00016}], "font": {"id": "7265595305163231781", "path": "C:/HarmonyOS_Sans_SC_Regular.ttf"}}], "text": "音音,你不是能看脚印吗?收集一下信息。"}

{"styles": [{"fill": {"alpha": 1.0, "content": {"render_type": "solid", "solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [0.9411764705882353, 1.0, 0.0]}}}, "range": [0, 15], "size": 5.0, "bold": false, "italic": false, "underline": false, "strokes": [{"content": {"solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [0.0, 0.0, 0.0]}}, "width": 0.00016}], "font": {"id": "7265595305163231781", "path": "C:/HarmonyOS_Sans_SC_Regular.ttf"}}], "text": "关我毛事,你是队长,你自己找。"}

{"styles": [{"fill": {"alpha": 1.0, "content": {"render_type": "solid", "solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [0.9411764705882353, 1.0, 0.0]}}}, "range": [0, 6], "size": 5.0, "bold": false, "italic": false, "underline": false, "strokes": [{"content": {"solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [0.0, 0.0, 0.0]}}, "width": 0.00016}], "font": {"id": "7265595305163231781", "path": "C:/HarmonyOS_Sans_SC_Regular.ttf"}}], "text": "老邓,起来!"}

{"styles": [{"fill": {"alpha": 1.0, "content": {"render_type": "solid", "solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [0.9411764705882353, 1.0, 0.0]}}}, "range": [0, 15], "size": 5.0, "bold": false, "italic": false, "underline": false, "strokes": [{"content": {"solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [0.0, 0.0, 0.0]}}, "width": 0.00016}], "font": {"id": "7265595305163231781", "path": "C:/HarmonyOS_Sans_SC_Regular.ttf"}}], "text": "行了,行了,甭管它,我自己来。"}

{"styles": [{"fill": {"alpha": 1.0, "content": {"render_type": "solid", "solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [0.9411764705882353, 1.0, 0.0]}}}, "range": [0, 4], "size": 5.0, "bold": false, "italic": false, "underline": false, "strokes": [{"content": {"solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [0.0, 0.0, 0.0]}}, "width": 0.00016}], "font": {"id": "7265595305163231781", "path": "C:/HarmonyOS_Sans_SC_Regular.ttf"}}], "text": "找到了。"}

{"styles": [{"fill": {"alpha": 1.0, "content": {"render_type": "solid", "solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [0.9411764705882353, 1.0, 0.0]}}}, "range": [0, 14], "size": 5.0, "bold": false, "italic": false, "underline": false, "strokes": [{"content": {"solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [0.0, 0.0, 0.0]}}, "width": 0.00016}], "font": {"id": "7265595305163231781", "path": "C:/HarmonyOS_Sans_SC_Regular.ttf"}}], "text": "我以阿萨拉老奶的名义,命了!"}

{"styles": [{"fill": {"alpha": 1.0, "content": {"render_type": "solid", "solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [0.9411764705882353, 1.0, 0.0]}}}, "range": [0, 6], "size": 5.0, "bold": false, "italic": false, "underline": false, "strokes": [{"content": {"solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [0.0, 0.0, 0.0]}}, "width": 0.00016}], "font": {"id": "7265595305163231781", "path": "C:/HarmonyOS_Sans_SC_Regular.ttf"}}], "text": "害死的老奶!"}

{"styles": [{"fill": {"alpha": 1.0, "content": {"render_type": "solid", "solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [0.9411764705882353, 1.0, 0.0]}}}, "range": [0, 20], "size": 5.0, "bold": false, "italic": false, "underline": false, "strokes": [{"content": {"solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [0.0, 0.0, 0.0]}}, "width": 0.00016}], "font": {"id": "7265595305163231781", "path": "C:/HarmonyOS_Sans_SC_Regular.ttf"}}], "text": "阿德森的护卫队,他们也来抢面具碎片了吗?"}

{"styles": [{"fill": {"alpha": 1.0, "content": {"render_type": "solid", "solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [0.9411764705882353, 1.0, 0.0]}}}, "range": [0, 12], "size": 5.0, "bold": false, "italic": false, "underline": false, "strokes": [{"content": {"solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [0.0, 0.0, 0.0]}}, "width": 0.00016}], "font": {"id": "7265595305163231781", "path": "C:/HarmonyOS_Sans_SC_Regular.ttf"}}], "text": "护卫小队怎么失去联系了?"}

{"styles": [{"fill": {"alpha": 1.0, "content": {"render_type": "solid", "solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [0.9411764705882353, 1.0, 0.0]}}}, "range": [0, 4], "size": 5.0, "bold": false, "italic": false, "underline": false, "strokes": [{"content": {"solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [0.0, 0.0, 0.0]}}, "width": 0.00016}], "font": {"id": "7265595305163231781", "path": "C:/HarmonyOS_Sans_SC_Regular.ttf"}}], "text": "高萨文。"}

{"styles": [{"fill": {"alpha": 1.0, "content": {"render_type": "solid", "solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [0.9411764705882353, 1.0, 0.0]}}}, "range": [0, 7], "size": 5.0, "bold": false, "italic": false, "underline": false, "strokes": [{"content": {"solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [0.0, 0.0, 0.0]}}, "width": 0.00016}], "font": {"id": "7265595305163231781", "path": "C:/HarmonyOS_Sans_SC_Regular.ttf"}}], "text": "我这就去看看。"}

{"styles": [{"fill": {"alpha": 1.0, "content": {"render_type": "solid", "solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [0.9411764705882353, 1.0, 0.0]}}}, "range": [0, 18], "size": 5.0, "bold": false, "italic": false, "underline": false, "strokes": [{"content": {"solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [0.0, 0.0, 0.0]}}, "width": 0.00016}], "font": {"id": "7265595305163231781", "path": "C:/HarmonyOS_Sans_SC_Regular.ttf"}}], "text": "老奶,你就把碎片给我吧,我们是好人。"}

{"styles": [{"fill": {"alpha": 1.0, "content": {"render_type": "solid", "solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [0.9411764705882353, 1.0, 0.0]}}}, "range": [0, 3], "size": 5.0, "bold": false, "italic": false, "underline": false, "strokes": [{"content": {"solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [0.0, 0.0, 0.0]}}, "width": 0.00016}], "font": {"id": "7265595305163231781", "path": "C:/HarmonyOS_Sans_SC_Regular.ttf"}}], "text": "不给。"}

{"styles": [{"fill": {"alpha": 1.0, "content": {"render_type": "solid", "solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [0.9411764705882353, 1.0, 0.0]}}}, "range": [0, 14], "size": 5.0, "bold": false, "italic": false, "underline": false, "strokes": [{"content": {"solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [0.0, 0.0, 0.0]}}, "width": 0.00016}], "font": {"id": "7265595305163231781", "path": "C:/HarmonyOS_Sans_SC_Regular.ttf"}}], "text": "哎呀,老奶,我真的是大善人。"}
